data.one_liner: Single-line text widget that automatically scrolls long content.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AutoScrollText widget that automatically scrolls text horizontally or vertically so that long content remains fully readable without overlapping or being cut off by ellipses. It supports endless and bouncing scroll modes, adjustable velocity, delays, round limits, and selectable text.
use_when: You need to display a single line of text that might be too long to fit in the available horizontal or vertical space.
You want automatic marquee-style scrolling without manual controller management.
You need options like bouncing back and forth, limiting scroll rounds, or falling back to a text overflow after a set number of repetitions.
avoid_when: You need multi-line paragraphs or text wrapping.
You are targeting Dart or Flutter versions older than Dart 3.8 / Flutter 3.32.
strengths: Supports both endless and bouncing scroll modes in horizontal and vertical directions.
Provides configurable velocity, animation curves, pauses, and repetition limits.
Supports selectable text and optional overflow handling once scrolling stops.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to single-line text content.
Requires recent versions of Dart (3.8+) and Flutter (3.32+).
